name: cax-workflow-agent
description: MCP-powered Agent for automated SolidWorks-to-HyperMesh-to-Abaqus workflows, web-researched troubleshooting, and engineering-aware recovery

interface.shortDescription: Automate CAx workflows and recover from engineering failures.
interface.longDescription: CAX Workflow Agent connects SolidWorks modeling, HyperMesh preprocessing and C3D8R meshing, Abaqus job control, and ODB postprocessing through typed MCP adapters. It plans resumable workflows, diagnoses failures, researches unknown errors in official web documentation, promotes only locally verified solutions into reusable knowledge, and verifies every inter-application handoff.
defaultPrompt: 规划并执行 SolidWorks 建模、HyperMesh 网格、Abaqus 分析与后处理的全链路流程。
诊断这份 CAE 错误日志，说明原因、恢复步骤和需要用户批准的变更。
读取案例状态，继续上次中断的 CAx 工作流并验证每个交付。
